extracted.name: Best Marinara Sauce Yet
extracted.description: This marinara sauce recipe is a delicious blend of tomatoes, parsley, garlic, and oregano simmered with onion and white wine for amazing flavor.
instruction_lines: Place tomatoes, tomato paste, parsley, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper in a food processor; blend until smooth.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until slightly softened, about 2 minutes.
Stir in blended tomato sauce and white wine.
Simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, about 30 minutes.
